name: Kasuya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kasuya town emblem in green: a disc with two leaves at the top and a white stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Kasuya, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 December 1983.

features.role: Kasuya town emblem — a disc with two leaves at the top and a white stylised device
